title: FoMobToggle
description: Personal GUI and permission-controlled toggles for nearby natural mob spawns.
body:
![Cover Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79c11226349c1b77e45061425e6bef463b68d59f.png)
**Let players control nearby natural mob spawning with a clean GUI and permission-based overrides.**

FoMobToggle gives players three simple toggles: all mobs, monsters, and passive mobs. Server owners can let players manage the settings themselves, or lock the final behavior through permission nodes for ranks, perks, or protected areas.

![FoMobToggle GUI with all mobs, monsters, and passive mob toggles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97199c2699689f87653dc76faf687b72b92ef446.png)

## Features

- Give players a compact GUI for all mobs, hostile mobs, and passive mobs.
- Block natural and chunk-generation spawns around players based on their effective settings.
- Use permission nodes as final overrides when a setting should be rank-controlled.
- Save per-player GUI choices to user data files.
- Disable the GUI while keeping permission-based spawn blocking active.
- Tune the nearby-player spawn check radius from config.

![Toggle item lore showing current result, saved GUI state, and permission mode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/590bde0c2a297cc2b7bb89e3c0c8c443214ec594.png)


![Permission override example in the GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93b1658b9a5dc4017d40a08f98ff2e4bac6f2c6a.png)

## Dependencies

FoMobToggle has no required external plugin dependencies.

## Commands

- `/fomobtoggle` - Open the mob toggle menu.
- Aliases: `/mobtoggle`, `/togglemob`, `/mobstogle`, `/togglemobs`

## Permissions

- `fomobtoggle.use` - Open the FoMobToggle GUI.
- `fomobtoggle.spawn.mob` - Final override for all mob spawning around the player.
- `fomobtoggle.spawn.monster` - Final override for monster spawning around the player.
- `fomobtoggle.spawn.passive` - Final override for passive mob spawning around the player.
